title: DrugIntelHub
description: A searchable web application for drug and medicine information, built to give users clear answers quickly from a large and varied dataset. Features a dual-database architecture with MongoDB for flexible records and MySQL for relational data, backed by a high-performance Python engine.

title: Hindustan Franchise
description: A franchise directory website that helps prospective investors browse, compare and enquire about franchise opportunities. Features category-based listings, streamlined enquiry forms with notifications, on-page SEO foundation, and intuitive WordPress CMS management.

title: MyStikWrap
description: A full website re-design for an existing brand that needed a cleaner look and faster pages. Rebuilt from the ground up in React.js, optimizing Core Web Vitals, responsive layouts, cross-browser performance, and conversion-guided user flows.

title: SksInfosystems
description: A corporate website for a cybersecurity company, built to communicate security services clearly and earn trust quickly. Hardened setup with HTTPS, fast pages, and an accessible structure that explains offensive and defensive services without jargon.

title: EcomBizGrow
description: An e-commerce website built to make buying simple, from finding a product to checking out. Includes an organized product catalogue, payment and shipping integration, search-optimized pages, and high mobile speed on WooCommerce.

title: Tacitine
description: Next-generation unified network security and deep packet inspection (DPI) platform engineered for enterprise defense against zero-day exploits, advanced intrusions, and zero-trust policy orchestration in a high-throughput appliance.
